statement: TSMC's advanced-packaging (CoWoS) capacity is sold out through 2026 with lead times ~52-78 weeks and bookings into 2027, tightly constraining merchant-GPU accelerator output.
why: CoWoS packaging is the binding constraint on NVIDIA/AMD accelerator supply; TSMC's CEO says tightness is limiting customer growth.

impact.mechanism: Sold-out CoWoS with 52-78 week lead times caps how many accelerators can be packaged, limiting merchant-GPU shipment volume.

evidence.source: TSMC Q2 2026 earnings (via BigGo Finance, Investing.com, Tech Times)
evidence.excerpt: Our packaging capacity is so tight that now it's limiting my customers' growth.

evidence.source: TSMC Q2 2026 earnings (via BigGo Finance, Investing.com, Tech Times)
